messages:
eli-fin: Customer Polaris opened a billing dispute for 2026-03-05 claiming ~400k embeds billed during a period they say hit client-side rate limits and should have been scoped as throttled (non-billable). They attached SDK logs. Can data/eng confirm?

noah-eng: share org_id and sample request_ids please. Curious whether these are duplicates or legitimately billed during retries.

rachel-data: org_id=polaris-inc. Quick counts on embed_events for region=na between 2026-03-05T14:00 and 2026-03-05T15:30 UTC: raw_rows=1,203,456 distinct(request_id, ack_id)=803,112 => delta ~= 400,344. Looks like duplicates but also many entries marked with client_retry=true in event metadata.

noah-eng: checked edge-rate-limiter logs — there was a short misconfiguration where an internal soft-limit returned 429 but our gateway treated it as 200 for a subset of clients, leading SDKs to retry and eventually succeed. Example: [2026-03-05T14:07:12Z] gateway return=200 but rl_status=429 header present; client retried.

zoe-cs: customer says they saw SDK-level throttles and expected our billing to exclude those attempts. They sent a redline asking for a credit equal to the 400k embeds.

eli-fin: proposed flow: 1) issue provisional credit for estimated 400k embeds ($440 at $0.0011/embed), 2) eng/data run full dedupe and mark events where gateway returned 429 in header as non-billable if pipeline confirms ack never delivered, 3) true-up next invoice. Approve provisional?

noah-eng: technical caveat — our ingest records include a header flag from gateway but some older proxies didn’t propagate the 429 header reliably. Dedup+header correlation should reduce false positives. I’m comfortable with provisional credit $450 to be safe.

billing-bot: created provisional credit ticket FIN-2607 for $450 for polaris-inc period=2026-03-05 reason="gateway rate-limit misclassification -> duplicate embeds" status=pending-approval.

eli-fin: I approve provisional credit and notified customer: "Weve placed a provisional credit while we reconcile logs and run a dedupe. Final reconciliation by Tue EOD." Customer replied :ok_hand:.

rachel-data: launching dedupe+header-correlation job now; ETA ~5h. Will post final distinct counts and recommend final credit amount.

eli-fin: thanks everyone. Keep notes on which proxies missed header propagation for follow-up billability logic change.
